title: Mara and the Border
author: Odile Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Pemberton, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
